name: codex-orchestration
description: Fast Terra-first numeric routing across six model lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Fast credit routing with one numeric score
interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration for the current chat with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Its stable user-level runtime hook runs once per prompt and sends up to 64 recent turns from that chat only to GPT-5.6 Terra / High without loading a routing skill, scanning the transcript, or generating a receipt. Terra assigns one immutable complexity score from 1.0 to 10.0, immediately surfaces one concise score-and-route checkpoint at the task level, and uses six implementation lanes: Luna / Max at 1.0–2.9, Terra / Medium at 3.0–5.0, Terra / High at 5.1–6.5, Sol / Low at 6.6–7.2, Sol / Medium at 7.3–7.9, and Sol / High at 8.0–10.0. Terra owns executive review below 5.0; root Sol / High owns it at 5.0 and above. Routine, fully specified Git and SSH deployment is allowed in the Terra route and does not itself force escalation. A steering correction drains only the active Orchestration branch before the revised task is rescored, while completed side effects are reconciled rather than assumed rolled back. Each producer self-checks, the owning executive checks once, and at most one correction is sent to the same producer. Detailed usage comparison remains an on-demand offline diagnostic.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat, score-based routing across six model lanes.
